tldr: The Sun in Capricorn: identity built through responsibility, mastery, and long-term creation.
body: With the Sun in Capricorn, the core self strengthens through discipline, structure, ambition, and earned authority. You are here to build something durable without sacrificing your humanity to the climb.
gift: Strategy, endurance, leadership, patience, and the ability to turn effort into legacy.
challenge: Coldness, workaholism, and measuring worth only by achievement.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
